# Check the response rate by arm, stratified by severity
response_by_arm_severity = trial_df_dedup.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().reset_index()
print('Response rate by arm and severity:')

# We'll compute the difference in response rate between treatment and control within each severity level
response_diff = response_by_arm_severity.pivot(index='severity', columns='arm', values='responded')
response_diff['treatment_control_diff'] = response_diff['treatment'] - response_diff['control']

print('\nDifference in response rate (treatment - control) by severity:')
print(response_diff[['treatment_control_diff']])"}
